features.name_mapping: macd_hist_z, trend_strength_z and fvg_distance are not in CANONICAL_FEATURES; macd_hist and trend_strength are used; fvg_distance is not tested

sequence.P1: cleaned run (+) whose start <= entry bar and sign at entry bar and bar before are +
sequence.N: next cleaned run (-) starting after the entry bar (adverse phase)
sequence.P2: next cleaned run (+) starting at or before the exit bar (recovery)
sequence.causality: P1 is entry-time; N and P2 use bars after entry, so the full sequence is descriptive/exit research, never an entry rule

adverse_bar: bar of maximum adverse excursion in entry+1..exit (exit bar for STOPPED)
